case_title: Knowledge Sharing Behavior of Nursing Educators: Influence of Organizational Culture and Technological Environment
evidence_statement: The questionnaire measured how many teaching resources educators had shared, and whether technology helped them obtain and share educational resources.

case_title: Knowledge Sharing Behavior of Nursing Educators: Influence of Organizational Culture and Technological Environment
evidence_statement: The quality measure asked whether shared teaching content could solve colleagues' practical problems; 75 percent reported that it could.
object_definition: Shared educational content intended to address colleagues' practical problems.

case_title: Knowledge Sharing Behavior of Nursing Educators: Influence of Organizational Culture and Technological Environment
evidence_statement: Educators reported sharing teaching experience in team discussions, and 68 percent said their experience was recognized and adopted.
object_definition: Experiential teaching knowledge shared by nursing educators.

case_title: Knowledge Sharing Behavior of Nursing Educators: Influence of Organizational Culture and Technological Environment
evidence_statement: The participation measure asked whether educators actively contributed personal knowledge and experience in teaching design.
object_definition: Personally held knowledge and experience contributed during teaching design.

case_title: Knowledge Sharing Behavior of Nursing Educators: Influence of Organizational Culture and Technological Environment
evidence_statement: Table 1 reports that teaching insights were shared proactively.

case_title: Knowledge Sharing Behavior of Nursing Educators: Influence of Organizational Culture and Technological Environment
evidence_statement: LMS was the most commonly used measured tool for daily teaching, with about 50 percent using it daily and 30 percent multiple times weekly.
object_definition: A digital learning-management system used in daily nursing teaching.

case_title: Knowledge Sharing Behavior of Nursing Educators: Influence of Organizational Culture and Technological Environment

case_title: Knowledge Sharing Behavior of Nursing Educators: Influence of Organizational Culture and Technological Environment

object_definition: Digital platforms used to conduct or support online nursing teaching.

case_title: Knowledge Sharing Behavior of Nursing Educators: Influence of Organizational Culture and Technological Environment
